The presence of a shared target gene between loratadine and fexofenadine implies that both drugs may act through similar pathways, potentially involving the same transporter. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between loratadine and the transporter, though the exact mechanism of action remains to be fully elucidated. The integration of the drug–disease relationship and the target gene suggests a plausible biological interaction, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct involvement of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2B1 in loratadine's pharmacological effects.
